# 1207 versus 1208: child protection

Assign 1207 when the summary centers on preventing or responding to child abuse, neglect, violence, or exploitation, including child protective services definitions, reports, and investigations. A study of services for children that expressly includes abuse and neglect alongside delinquency, dependency, and mental health belongs in 1207.

The supplied Title 23 bill granting immunity to people appointed to represent a minor child's interests is also a 1207 precedent. Its summary omits the proceeding, so do not extend that label to every minor representative or Title 23 bill.

Assign 1208 to marriage, divorce, custody, support, adoption, foster care, and general family or child welfare matters when the summary does not center on protecting children from abuse or neglect. Title 23 and generic child welfare wording alone do not determine the code.
